name: Trade and Invoice Financing Fraud
description: Borrowers finance the same receivable or goods more than once, forge invoices, or obtain advances on fictitious trade. Fraud may involve connected parties and weak verification of underlying transactions.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)
ICC, trade finance fraud and BAFT guidance (general)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)

indicators.name: Same invoice or bill of lading presented to multiple financiers
indicators.canon: Same invoice or shipment financed or invoiced multiple times
indicators.desc: The same invoice, bill of lading or goods are presented to multiple financiers or invoiced more than once.
indicators.ctx: Duplicate financing detected by registry or internal matching.
refs: FATF and Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)

indicators.name: Invoices from related parties with round values
indicators.canon: Invoices from related parties with round values
indicators.desc: Counterparties share ownership and amounts look artificial.

indicators.name: Repayments funded by new financing from same borrower
